title: Certificate: code/ports/cache.py
signature: Cache.get(key) -> dict | None ; Cache.put(key, value) -> None ; Cache.key(*parts, prompt_version) -> str
guarantees: Directory of <key>.json files under code/cache/, committed with the submission so the final run is reproducible offline.
Key = sha256 over the ordered parts plus prompt_version; bumping prompt_version is the only invalidation.
Reads/writes are atomic (temp + replace); a corrupt file is treated as a miss.
